title: Georgia DOT Bridge No. 151-00144-x-00055S, Spanning Little Cotton Indian Creek at Springdale Road (County Road 144), Stockbridge, Henry County, GA
notes: Significance: This bridge is historically significant in the area of engineering as an example of a steel Warren pony truss bridge with verticals.
